limits: Received REK_Hit effects packets confirm client receipt, not complete enumeration of all server contacts; delivery is unreliable. No received hit leaves contact unknown.
Decoded is_kick 0/1 is retained; no known canned clip ID, hand/foot side, target body zone, rejected attempt, pair key, or authoritative collider manifold is present.
All observed hit-score pairs share one Unity frame, but even a unique pairing is noncausal and supplies only a scoring-slot attacker candidate.
Five-point awards are separate. None in these full or short capture rows has a same-frame received hit; absence does not prove absence of contact or identify the award cause.
Packets have Unity frame, Unity time, unscaled time and realtime receipt time. No per-hit QPC/UTC or server impact time is available.

Native-only joins report inconsistent_unity_frame_time. FixedUpdate time and receive-callback frame time differ; each preserves 8, 9 or 14 same-frame roots in these captures. A sub-2 ms Unity-time offset is not impact-time precision.
Heading is projected root-local +X in Unity XZ, not Unity +Z forward, controller heading or aiming intent. All geometry is rendered/replicated client context.
Neutral velocity, pending-move false and punching false are sampled evidence. Neutral control leaves physics and opponent AI active; it does not immobilize the defender.
Native-only follow-up and recovery captures have no paired runner/relay proof of a fresh neutral request; their recorded compact input and outbound transport observations are reported directly.
No exact action-position repeatability, failed-contact classifier, policy improvement or hitbox model has been established.
